name: Jegeren
description: En snill jeger som finner noen rufsete fugleunger i gresset og vil ta dem med hjem, fordi han tror de ikke har noen mor.
visualPrompt: A friendly forest wanderer in simple outdoor clothes with a small satchel, soft features and a calm smile, kneeling carefully with empty open hands to show he means no harm, surrounded by leaves and dappled light

name: Myrsnipen
description: En liten fuglemor som ber jegeren la barna hennes være, for hun synes de er de vakreste i hele skogen.
visualPrompt: A small brown-and-tan wading bird with a slender beak and quick wings, hovering anxiously near the ground, bright attentive eyes, feathers slightly ruffled from concern but not threatening

name: Myrsnipungene
description: Små, rufsete fugleunger med dun som stritter til alle kanter, og som ikke sier annet enn «pip».
visualPrompt: Several tiny, fluffy chicks with mottled brown down, short legs, curious expressions, huddled close together on soft forest ground near moss and twigs, looking safe and snug
